policy: A slot vacated by a parser-feedback exclusion is refilled only in primary-rank order, and only by the next-ranked control-verified path whose own pinned Docker control and parser-derived AFL++ overlay receipt passed. An unresolved next-ranked path stops the refill; a next-ranked path with a recorded feedback blocker stays excluded and the walk continues.

paths.name: plyparser
paths.note: Next-ranked npm path after the @draco-rust/ply feedback blocker. Pinned Docker control passes with 165 parser-source lines; the AFL++ bridge maps 47 parser features to 67 tuples, repeats identically on triangle.ply and gives a different 56-tuple map on triangle-colour.ply.

paths.name: pyntcloud
paths.note: First next-ranked PyPI path after the PyMeshLab and libigl feedback blockers (rank 11, 46,262 downloads). Pinned Docker control passes with 805 pyntcloud source lines (PLY reader pyntcloud/io/ply.py); the AFL++ Python bridge maps them to 817 tuples, repeats identically on triangle.ply and gives a different 812-tuple map on a valid coloured two-face square.
